clusters.headline: Prabowo Subianto Nominates Sugiono and Amran Sulaiman as VP Candidates
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto formally submitted the names of Sugiono and Andi Amran Sulaiman to the MPR as candidates for vice president.
The candidates were selected based on stated criteria of achievement, dedication, and loyalty to the nation.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Submits Two Wapres Candidates to MPR
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto officially submitted two candidates for the vice president position to the MPR.
The names were proposed as replacements for Gibran Rakabuming Raka.

clusters.headline: Prabowo Proposes Sugiono and Amran as MPR Postpones VP Election
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto officially submitted Sugiono and Amran as candidates for the vacant Vice President position to the MPR.
The People's Consultative Assembly (MPR) rescheduled the plenary session for the election and inauguration of the new Vice President to December 11, 2026.

clusters.headline: Search Operations Continue After Fire at PT Fonusa Agung Mulia
aiSummaryBullets: Recovery efforts are ongoing at the PT Fonusa Agung Mulia factory in Cikande following a major fire.
Authorities are working to identify victims, with families providing data to assist the forensic process.

clusters.headline: Polda Metro Jaya Ungkap Penipuan Online dan Rombak Jajaran Pejabat
aiSummaryBullets: Polda Metro Jaya menangkap sembilan tersangka kasus penipuan daring yang mencakup berbagai modus dengan total kerugian mencapai Rp1,2 miliar.
Pihak kepolisian mencatat telah menangani lebih dari 4.000 kasus penipuan daring dengan estimasi total kerugian masyarakat mencapai Rp1,49 triliun.

clusters.headline: Polri Seizes Narcotics Worth Rp 1 Trillion From Indonesia-Malaysia Ring
aiSummaryBullets: A joint operation involving Polri, BNN, and Customs officials dismantled an international narcotics ring operating between Indonesia and Malaysia.
Authorities confiscated narcotics including methamphetamine and etomidate with a total estimated market value of Rp 1.01 trillion.

clusters.headline: Surabaya, Tangerang And Transjakarta Receive National Awards 2026
aiSummaryBullets: Surabaya was honored with two national awards for its advancements in smart city innovations.
Tangerang received recognition for its excellence in the implementation of green industry practices.

clusters.headline: Kecelakaan Maut Di Sumedang Resulting In Seven Fatalities
aiSummaryBullets: A multi-vehicle accident involving eight vehicles occurred on the Cirebon-Bandung road in Sumedang.
West Java regional police officials reported that seven individuals died in the incident.

clusters.headline: Jakarta And Regional Officials Respond To Multiple Landslide Events
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta authorities are planning to build a permanent retaining wall in Pejaten Timur following recurring landslides triggered by heavy rain.
Emergency response teams have been deployed to South Jakarta to assist displaced residents and manage the impact of recent soil instability.

clusters.headline: Komnas HAM Forms Selection Committee For 2027-2032 Commissioners
aiSummaryBullets: Komnas HAM has officially appointed a five-member committee to oversee the selection process for commissioners serving from 2027 to 2032.
Registration for the upcoming commissioner candidate cycle is scheduled to commence throughout the month of December.

clusters.headline: KPU Denies Ethics Allegations Regarding Gibran Rakabuming Candidacy
aiSummaryBullets: The General Elections Commission (KPU) denied allegations of restricting Silon access to the Elections Supervisory Body (Bawaslu).
Complainants have requested the permanent dismissal of KPU commissioners during the DKPP ethics hearings.

clusters.headline: Tito Karnavian and Bima Arya Push for Regional Economic Integration
aiSummaryBullets: Minister Tito Karnavian is prioritizing the harmonization of over 17,000 regional regulations to improve administrative efficiency.
Bima Arya is encouraging local governments to develop specific regional economic ecosystems by mapping potential sectors and resources.

clusters.headline: Polda Metro Jaya Probes Suspect In Crypto Love Scam Case
aiSummaryBullets: Authorities are investigating a cryptocurrency investment fraud operating through love scams.
Victims of the fraudulent scheme reported financial losses reaching Rp 136 million.

clusters.headline: Erin Mantan Istri Andre Taulany Jadi Tersangka Kasus Penganiayaan
aiSummaryBullets: Erin Wartia ditetapkan sebagai tersangka atas laporan dugaan penganiayaan terhadap mantan asisten rumah tangganya, Herawati.
Pihak Erin Wartia menyatakan terbuka terhadap peluang perdamaian melalui mekanisme restorative justice.

clusters.headline: Bahlil Lahadalia Denies Mining Permits For Ujung Kulon National Park
aiSummaryBullets: Coordinating Minister Bahlil Lahadalia confirmed no mining business licenses exist for Ujung Kulon National Park.
The Ministry of Forestry stated that mining permits will not be issued for the protected area serving as the Javan rhino's habitat.

clusters.headline: DPD RI Chair Sultan Najamudin Proposes Three Vice President Roles
aiSummaryBullets: Sultan Najamudin, Chair of the DPD RI, proposed the potential addition of three vice president positions to support national governance.
The official stated the concept is not intended for the immediate term but is presented as a long-term idea for consideration.

clusters.headline: Subulussalam Government Proposes River Normalization To Curb Floods
aiSummaryBullets: Subulussalam officials proposed a one trillion rupiah plan to normalize the Lae Soraya River and construct the Oboh Canal.
Coordinating Minister for Human Development and Culture Sugiono conducted a field inspection to assess flood damage in Aceh.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Nationals Recruited As Russian Mercenaries Intercepted
aiSummaryBullets: Two Indonesian citizens attempting to join Russian military operations were stopped at an airport in Surabaya.
The individuals allegedly claimed to be traveling for vacation before their recruitment was discovered.

clusters.headline: Gibran Rakabuming Raka Leads Initiative for Kopdes Merah Putih
aiSummaryBullets: Government aims to have 10,000 Kopdes Merah Putih units operational by late 2026.
The initiative seeks to facilitate social assistance distribution and agricultural output absorption.

clusters.headline: Sekolah Rakyat Program Expansion Gains Momentum Across Indonesia
aiSummaryBullets: The Sekolah Rakyat program continues to expand in regions including Lombok Utara, Temanggung, and Pekanbaru to support out-of-school youth.
Data indicates a 32.37 percent reduction in the number of out-of-school children in West Java throughout 2026.
